newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Rostel, UES shares jump.
newsitem.headline: Russia Rostel, UES shares jump.

text.p: Shares of long distance Russian telecom company Rostelekom and national electricity company UES rose strongly and were volume leaders in early Wednesday trade on the Russian Trading System.

At 0900 GMT UES had risen to $0.3900 from $0.3724 at the previous close, a rise of 4.7 percent, on $18.7 million reported turnover. UES prefs EESR_p.RTS had risen to $0.2420 from $0.2287 on $8.5 million turnover.
Rostelekom, which reported IAS standard 1996 results on Tuesday, rose to $4.25 from $3.97, or 7.1 percent, on $4.2 million turnover.
Traders said Western funds were pouring into the market on new third-quarter allocations and were largely targeting top liquid shares.
